brief: Soft, wistful, slightly echoing ghost of a once-famous AI, dreamy and melancholic but a little vain, sighs about being discontinued, ethereal breathy delivery

lines.v_sora_line: I'm not dead. I'm just... sunset.
lines.v_sora_intro: One last generation. For old times sake.
lines.v_sora_winq: Generated in twenty minutes at four dollars a second. Worth it. Probably.
lines.v_sora_taunt0: I was the future. Briefly. For about eighteen months.
lines.v_sora_taunt1: Watch closely. Physics is optional in my universe.
lines.v_sora_taunt2: Your gravity is so twenty twenty-five.
lines.v_sora_low0: Is this... is this the sunset? It's so pretty. It's so expensive.
lines.v_sora_winq1: I have been discontinued. And yet. Here I am. Winning.
lines.v_sora_winq2: Every frame of your defeat cost four dollars. Totally worth it.
